title: The experiment that created Albert Wesker in Resident Evil
subject: wesker
description:
Would you have trusted Captain Wesker? 👇

How Albert Wesker went from Umbrella's secret program to captain of S.T.A.R.S. Spoilers for Resident Evil and Resident Evil 5.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Albert Wesker grew up inside someone else's experiment.
Umbrella founder Ozwell Spencer collected gifted children and gave every one of them the same surname: Wesker.
Albert never knew why. By 1978 he was a researcher at Umbrella's Arklay Laboratory, beside William Birkin.
Later he joined Umbrella's intelligence division and took a cover job in Raccoon City, as captain of S.T.A.R.S.
In July 1998 he sent his own team into the Spencer Mansion, so Umbrella's creatures could be tested on them.
He thought every step was his own choice. Spencer had made that choice for him decades earlier.
